remarks: HUNTER'S RETREAT NEAR RUSHFORD LAKE! Tucked away on nearly 2 scenic acres, this 2-bedroom, 2-bath manufactured home offers an ideal basecamp for hunters and outdoor enthusiasts. With two deeded rights-of-way providing access to nearby state land, you’ll have convenient access for hunting, hiking, scouting, and exploring the surrounding woods. After a day outdoors, come back to the warmth and comfort of the wood-burning stove and propane furnace. One bedroom features built-in bunk beds, providing plenty of sleeping space for hunting buddies, family, or guests. The home is being offered fully furnished with all appliances included, making it ready to enjoy as a hunting camp or recreational getaway. The property also features a private pond stocked with bluegill and grass carp, adding to the peaceful, secluded setting. When you're not in the woods, Rushford Lake is just minutes away, offering boating, swimming, fishing, and kayaking for even more outdoor recreation. With nearly 2 acres of privacy, deeded access to nearby state land, a private stocked pond, and Rushford Lake just minutes away, this property offers a comfortable home base for hunting season and year-round outdoor adventures.
